caseName: C. C. Taft Co. v. Iowa
caseNameFull: C. C. Taft Company v. State of Iowa
summary: Error to the Supreme Court of the State of Iowa.
attorneys: Mr. Fred P. Carr and Mr. Robert M. Haines for plaintiff in error, submitted., Mr. F. C. Davidson, with whom Mr. H. M. Havner was on the brief, for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of the Act of September 6, 1916, c. 448, § 6, 39 Stat. 726, 727.
